zh.title: Air Tahiti全頭等艙ATR 72-600展開法國至大溪地六日九機場航程
zh.summary: Air Tahiti展開法國至大溪地六日九座機場航程
body: Air Tahiti一架全頭等艙ATR 72-600已展開從法國前往大溪地的旅程。Simple Flying標題稱，這段航程為期六天、涵蓋九座機場；報導摘要也表示，這架飛機正踏上這趟行程。
報導摘要將這架飛機描述為豪華的26席ATR 72-600，並稱它正在展開這段六天、九座機場的旅程。標題所述航程由法國前往大溪地；目前提供的報導文字描述的是旅程展開，並未表示飛機已抵達目的地。

en.title: Air Tahiti's All-First-Class ATR 72-600 Begins Journey to Tahiti
en.summary: Air Tahiti begins a six-day, nine-airport journey from France to Tahiti.
body: Air Tahiti has begun a journey from France to Tahiti aboard an all-first-class ATR 72-600. Simple Flying’s headline describes the trip as spanning six days and nine airports, while its summary says the aircraft is embarking on the journey.

The summary describes the aircraft as a luxurious 26-seat ATR 72-600. It also characterizes the journey as a six-day trip involving nine airports between France and Tahiti. The report describes the journey as underway; it does not say the aircraft has completed the trip or arrived in Tahiti.

zh.title: 新機交付短缺預期至少延續至2030年
zh.summary: 航空公司新機交付短缺預期至少延續至2030年；IATA稱訂單積壓逾1.8萬架
body: Cirium於2026年10月13日發布年度機隊預測，預期製造商在2020年代剩餘時間仍無法滿足航空公司需求。航空公司等待新機交付的短缺預料還會持續數年，發動機供應、供應商瓶頸及認證延誤預期將限制產量至少至2030年。
Cirium預測，2026年至2045年間將交付約4.3萬架新商用客運及貨運飛機，按2026年價格計值3.2兆美元。該公司表示，這些噴射機與渦輪螺旋槳飛機將讓航空公司擴充機隊並汰換老舊飛機。
國際航空運輸協會（IATA）表示，航空公司原本預期已可接收、但至今仍短缺超過5,000架省油飛機。IATA另稱，飛機訂單積壓已超過18,000架。可用替換機較少時，航空公司延長舊機飛行時間，並增加維修支出與租賃費用。

en.title: New-aircraft delivery shortages expected to persist until at least 2030
en.summary: Airlines face aircraft delivery shortages through 2030; IATA says the backlog exceeds 18,000 aircraft.
body: Cirium released its annual fleet forecast on October 13, 2026, and expects manufacturers to remain unable to meet airline demand throughout the rest of the 2020s. Airlines waiting for new aircraft face several more years of delivery shortages, with engine availability, supplier bottlenecks and certification delays expected to constrain production until at least 2030.

Cirium forecasts about 43,000 deliveries of new commercial passenger and cargo aircraft between 2026 and 2045, worth $3.2 trillion at 2026 prices. The company says the jets and turboprops will allow airlines to expand their fleets and replace aging aircraft.

The International Air Transport Association said airlines were short of more than 5,000 fuel-efficient aircraft they had expected to receive by then. IATA also said the aircraft order backlog exceeded 18,000. With fewer replacements available, carriers are keeping older airplanes flying longer, spending more on maintenance and paying higher lease rates.

zh.title: 美國議員要求FAA暫停華盛頓地區AI空管工具
zh.summary: 美國議員要求FAA暫停華府地區AI空管工具並答覆安全測試與人員訓練問題
body: 美國逾兩打國會議員要求聯邦航空總署（FAA）暫停在華盛頓地區機場使用新的人工智慧空中交通工具，直到該機關回答有關安全測試與人員訓練的問題。這項要求是在2026年9月21日開始有限度運作後提出，當時涉及Reagan National（DCA）、Washington Dulles（IAD）及Baltimore/Washington International（BWI）的航班。
眾議員April McClain Delaney表示，國會信函已送交交通部長Sean Duffy及FAA局長Bryan Bedford。議員要求提供嚴重天氣及設備故障情境下的測試資料。FAA表示，SMART不會取代航管員；機關人員會檢視系統建議，地方空管主管可接受或拒絕。該工具整合約200項資料流，用於預測壅塞並建議調整排程。

en.title: US lawmakers urge FAA to pause AI traffic tool near Washington airports
en.summary: US lawmakers urge the FAA to pause its Washington-area AI traffic tool pending safety and training answers.
body: More than two dozen US lawmakers are urging the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to pause use of a new artificial intelligence tool for Washington-area air traffic until the agency answers questions about safety testing and staff training. The request came after limited operations involving flights at Reagan National (DCA), Washington Dulles (IAD) and Baltimore/Washington International (BWI) began on September 21, 2026. Representative April McClain Delaney said the letter was sent to Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford.

Lawmakers sought details about testing in severe weather and equipment outages. The FAA says SMART does not replace air traffic controllers: agency staff review its recommendations, and local air traffic control leaders can accept or reject them. The system combines about 200 data streams to forecast congestion and suggest scheduling changes before delays begin to cascade.

zh.title: 波音前九個月交付475架商用飛機，年增8%
zh.summary: 波音前九個月交付475架商用飛機，交付數字仍屬初步。
body: 波音2026年前九個月交付475架商用飛機，較去年同期增加8%。
其中，737交付量由2025年同期的330架增至367架。報導指出，737是波音年初至今交付增幅的主要部分。波音第三季交付161架，去年同期為160架。
2026年9月，波音交付57架，高於8月的51架及2025年9月的55架。波音表示，交付數字仍屬初步，直到第三季財報發布後才會更新。

en.title: Boeing reports 475 commercial aircraft deliveries in first nine months of 2026
en.summary: Boeing delivered 475 commercial aircraft through September; the figures remain preliminary.
body: Boeing delivered 475 commercial aircraft in the first nine months of 2026, an 8% increase from a year earlier.

Deliveries of the 737 rose to 367 from 330 in the first nine months of 2025. The report said the 737 accounted for most of Boeing’s year-to-date improvement. Boeing delivered 161 aircraft in the third quarter, compared with 160 in the same quarter a year earlier.
In September 2026, Boeing delivered 57 aircraft, up from 51 in August and 55 in September 2025. The company said the delivery figures remain preliminary until its third-quarter results are issued.

zh.title: 波音公佈2026年第三季商用與國防交付概況
zh.summary: 波音宣佈第三季商用及國防主要計畫交付；交付資料以季度財報為準
body: 波音（Boeing）於2026年10月13日宣佈2026年第三季主要計畫的交付情況，涵蓋商用與國防業務。
該公司說明，這批交付資訊同時涵蓋國防、太空與安全（Defense, Space & Security）計畫，以及商用與民用衛星（Commercial and Civil Satellites）。
波音指出，所列交付數量為新生產單位的交付，包含重製與改裝在內。
公司同時提醒，交付資訊在季度財務結果發布前，並不視為最終數據。
波音本次公佈的對象為投資人與媒體，並提供投資人關係與媒體聯絡信箱。
除上述交付分類與說明外，波音本次並未在公佈內容中列出各機型或各計畫的具體交付數字。

en.title: Boeing announces third-quarter 2026 commercial and defense deliveries
en.summary: Boeing announces Q3 2026 major program deliveries; figures not final until quarterly results
body: Boeing announced its major program deliveries for the third quarter of 2026, covering both commercial and defense operations.
The company said the delivery information spans Defense, Space & Security programs as well as Commercial and Civil Satellites.
Boeing described the listed deliveries as new-build production units, including remanufactures and modifications.
Boeing also noted that delivery information is not considered final until quarterly financial results are issued.
The announcement was issued by The Boeing Company, which is listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker BA.
Beyond the delivery categories and the accompanying note, the announcement as published did not set out specific delivery counts by program or aircraft type.

zh.title: 航空公司公佈2026/27冬季新增航線與復飛計畫
zh.summary: 聯合航空公佈冬季航線計畫，將開辦札幌與卡塔赫納航班
body: 航空公司正為2026/27冬季推出新航線；報導所列項目也包括季節性航班與復飛，開航日期仍可能變動。冬季航空季自2026年10月25日至2027年3月27日。聯合航空是新增航線的業者之一。
聯合航空計畫於12月11日開辦舊金山—札幌航線，每週三班，使用波音787-9。自12月17日起，該公司也將開辦休士頓—卡塔赫納及華盛頓杜勒斯—卡塔赫納航班，兩條航線各每週四班，使用波音737 MAX 8。

en.title: Airlines outline new and returning routes for winter 2026/27
en.summary: United plans winter flights to Sapporo and Cartagena on multiple routes
body: Airlines are preparing new services for the 2026/27 winter season. The route selection also includes seasonal services and resumptions, and launch dates remain subject to change. The winter aviation season runs from 25 October 2026 to 27 March 2027. United Airlines is among the carriers adding routes.

United plans to start San Francisco–Sapporo flights on 11 December, operating three times weekly with Boeing 787-9 aircraft. From 17 December, it is also introducing Houston–Cartagena and Washington Dulles–Cartagena services. Each of those routes is scheduled to operate four times weekly with Boeing 737 MAX 8 aircraft.
